subject: BrightLeaf security intake — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, and next steps
messages:
From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@brightleafhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's demo —SOC 2 & vendor intake

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — the team at BrightLeaf was impressed with the latency profile and the routing controls. Before we can move to an internal security review, a couple of items the InfoSec team asked me to collect: 

- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report we can review?
- Can you provide a bridge letter/attestation while the full report access is provisioned?
- We also need to kick off our vendor security questionnaire (we use a short DSQ + our in-house questionnaire). Can Redwood own initiating that or point me to the portal where we can upload answers?
- A note on data residency/compliance: BrightLeaf handles PHI under HIPAA for some customers — can you confirm Redwood's stance on processing PHI and any required BAAs?

If you can share the report/attestation and a trust-portal link, I can route to our security reviewers today. Ideal timeline from our side: access to materials within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Michael Torres
Head of Security Operations
BrightLeaf Health
michael.torres@brightleafhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

P.S. I can coordinate with our procurement lead if we end up needing a BAA or signing a vendor addendum — happy to include them once we confirm access.

Michael — thanks for the clear list and great timing. Our security process maps directly to those asks; below are immediate next steps and owners.

Action items (short):

- Karthik will provision Trust Portal access for BrightLeaf and upload the report + bridge letter; he will also start the DSQ intake so you can complete answers. (Owner: Karthik)
- Ben will coordinate any technical follow-ups and answer PHI/HIPAA questions (Owner: Ben)

Preliminary answers to your questions: 
- SOC 2 Type II: Yes — we completed a Type II for 2024; I will attach a redacted copy right away.
- Bridge letter: attached (pdf). This will cover the interim period while portal access is confirmed.
- Trust portal & DSQ: we use a secure evidence portal; you will receive an invite link and a temporary access code from Karthik. The portal accepts our standard DSQ export and CSV-based questionnaires.
- PHI/HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via our Private deployment and signed BAA for customers that need it. For hosted/API customers we can discuss options — Ben will outline the deployment/BAA path in a follow-up.

Timeline: Karthik will provision portal invites within business-day hours; if you need anything faster, flag here and we'll escalate.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (redacted), Bridge_Letter_BrightLeaf.pdf (interim)

Thanks — looping in Karthik and Ben to action.

Best,
